preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000.
For each test case, n must be between 2 and 1,000,000, and m must be between 1 and n/2.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: All elements in the array a must be between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= n // 2 for b_i in B) and len(set(B)) == m
preconditions.description: All elements in the set B must be distinct and between 1 and n/2.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum possible sum of the array a after applying the operations.
